schema.text: How confident are you cycling in urban traffic in your city?

options.text: Not confident at all — I avoid cycling in traffic
Not very confident — I cycle only when I have no alternative
Somewhat confident — I manage most situations comfortably
Very confident — I cycle in all conditions without difficulty
I have never cycled in urban traffic

en.#How confident are you cycling in urban: How confident are you cycling in urban traffic in your city?
en.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Not confident at all — I avoid cycling in traffic
en.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Not very confident — I cycle only when I have no alternative
en.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Somewhat confident — I manage most situations comfortably
en.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Very confident — I cycle in all conditions without difficulty
en.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: I have never cycled in urban traffic

it.#How confident are you cycling in urban: Quanto ti senti sicuro/a nel pedalare nel traffico urbano della tua città?
it.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Per niente sicuro/a — evito di pedalare nel traffico
it.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Poco sicuro/a — uso la bicicletta solo quando non ho alternative
it.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Abbastanza sicuro/a — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni senza particolari difficoltà
it.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Molto sicuro/a — pedalo in tutte le condizioni senza difficoltà
it.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Non ho mai pedalato nel traffico urbano

fr.#How confident are you cycling in urban: À quel point vous sentez-vous en confiance lorsque vous circulez à vélo dans le trafic urbain de votre ville ?
fr.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Pas du tout en confiance — j’évite de circuler à vélo dans le trafic
fr.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Peu en confiance — je circule à vélo dans le trafic seulement si je n’ai pas d’autre solution
fr.#Neither confident nor unconfident: Ni en confiance ni mal à l’aise
fr.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Plutôt en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations sans difficulté
fr.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Très en confiance — je circule à vélo dans toutes les situations sans difficulté
fr.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Je n’ai jamais circulé à vélo dans le trafic urbain

de.#How confident are you cycling in urban: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich beim Radfahren im Stadtverkehr?
de.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Gar nicht sicher — ich vermeide das Radfahren im Verkehr
de.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Eher unsicher — ich fahre nur im Verkehr, wenn ich keine andere Möglichkeit habe
de.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Eher sicher — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen gut zurecht
de.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Sehr sicher — ich fahre unter allen üblichen Bedingungen ohne große Probleme
de.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Ich bin noch nie im Stadtverkehr Fahrrad gefahren

tr.#How confident are you cycling in urban: Şehrinizde kent trafiğinde bisiklet kullanırken kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Hiç güvende hissetmiyorum — trafikte bisiklet kullanmaktan kaçınırım
tr.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Pek güvende hissetmiyorum — yalnızca başka seçeneğim olmadığında trafikte bisiklet kullanırım
tr.#Neither confident nor unconfident: Ne güvende ne de güvensiz hissediyorum
tr.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Oldukça güvende hissediyorum — çoğu durumla rahatça başa çıkabiliyorum
tr.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Çok güvende hissediyorum — çoğu koşulda zorlanmadan bisiklet kullanabiliyorum

fa.#How confident are you cycling in urban: هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری در ترافیک شهری چقدر احساس اطمینان می‌کنید؟
fa.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: اصلاً مطمئن نیستم — از دوچرخه‌سواری در ترافیک پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: خیلی مطمئن نیستم — فقط وقتی راه دیگری ندارم در ترافیک دوچرخه‌سواری می‌کنم
fa.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: تا حدی مطمئنم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را بدون مشکل مدیریت می‌کنم
fa.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: خیلی مطمئنم — در شرایط معمول بدون مشکل دوچرخه‌سواری می‌کنم
fa.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: تا به حال در ترافیک شهری دوچرخه‌سواری نکرده‌ام

hu.#How confident are you cycling in urban: Mennyire érzi magát magabiztosnak kerékpározás közben a városi forgalomban?
hu.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: Egyáltalán nem vagyok magabiztos — kerülöm a forgalomban való kerékpározást
hu.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: Nem igazán vagyok magabiztos — csak akkor kerékpározom forgalomban, ha nincs más lehetőségem
hu.#Neither confident nor unconfident: Sem magabiztosnak, sem bizonytalannak nem érzem magam
hu.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: Elég magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb helyzetet gond nélkül kezelem
hu.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: Nagyon magabiztos vagyok — a szokásos helyzetekben nehézség nélkül kerékpározom
hu.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: Még soha nem kerékpároztam városi forgalomban

ar.#How confident are you cycling in urban: ما مدى ثقتك بنفسك عند ركوب الدراجة في حركة المرور داخل المدينة؟
ar.#Not confident at all — I avoid cycling: لست واثقًا إطلاقًا — أتجنب ركوب الدراجة وسط حركة المرور
ar.#Not very confident — I cycle only when: ثقتي قليلة — أركب الدراجة وسط حركة المرور فقط عندما لا يكون لدي بديل
ar.#Somewhat confident — I manage most situ: واثق إلى حد ما — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف بسهولة
ar.#Very confident — I cycle in all conditi: واثق جدًا — أركب الدراجة في الظروف المعتادة دون صعوبة
ar.#I have never cycled in urban traffic: لم أركب الدراجة من قبل وسط حركة المرور في المدينة
